# Colour themes

The desktop app's One Light and One Dark Pro themes
(`apps/desktop/web/src/themes.css`) take their colours from these
projects, both MIT-licensed. Their licences are here so
`tools/third_party_notices.sh` puts them in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`.

- `one-light`: [Atom's One Light UI](https://github.com/atom/one-light-ui)
  and [One Light syntax](https://github.com/atom/one-light-syntax), GitHub Inc.
- `one-dark-pro`: [One Dark Pro](https://github.com/Binaryify/OneDark-Pro), Binaryify.
